decisions.reason: As a flagship line close to the core safety-footwear business, it is likely to be retained unless results clearly fall below aspirations, and the firm's innovation focus gives it room to continue learning from it.

This product fits the established offer but is more niche and easier to reallocate away from if it underperforms, so the drop risk is higher, though still not high enough to outweigh its strategic fit.
A multi-model safety shoe series close to the firm's main market is likely to stay because it supports the broad portfolio, although weaker-than-expected sales could lead to some rationalisation.
